projectDescription: Tari is a two-layer blockchain protocol — Layer 1 (Minotari) secured by proof-of-work mining and Layer 2 (the Ootle) for smart contracts and decentralized applications — with Tari Universe as the consumer mining app and XTM as the native token.
keyFeatures: Tari Universe: consumer-grade desktop mining app for Mac, Windows, and Linux
Minotari (XTM): proof-of-work Layer 1 blockchain with four mining algorithms (RandomX, SHA3x, Cuckaroo)
Ootle: Layer 2 smart-contract network powered by WASM templates
Turbine Model: burn XTM 1:1 to mint TARI tokens on L2
Emoji ID: human-friendly wallet address format built on Mimblewimble privacy
One-sided transactions: send XTM without the recipient being online
gRPC API for wallet and base node integration
Tari Ootle Wallet Daemon for L2 interaction
Payment ID / PayRef system for exchange deposit tracking
21 billion XTM total supply with tail emission
publicApiSurface: minotari_node (binary) — full node with gRPC on port 18142
minotari_console_wallet (binary) — terminal wallet with gRPC on port 18143
tari CLI — create, build, and publish Ootle templates
Wallet gRPC: GetBalance, GetAddress, GetCompleteAddress, GetPaymentIdAddress, Transfer, GetCompletedTransactions, StreamTransactionEvents, GetPaymentByReference
Base Node gRPC: GetTipInfo, GetSyncInfo, GetSyncProgress, GetVersion, Identify, ListConnectedPeers, SearchPaymentReferences
tari_template_lib — Rust library for writing Ootle smart contract templates
ResourceBuilder, ComponentBuilder, Vault, Bucket, AccessRules — core L2 template primitives
